definitions.cent: a monetary unit equal to one hundredth of a dollar or other decimal currency unit.
definitions.eel: a snake-like fish with a slender elongated body and poorly developed fins, proverbial for its slipperiness.
definitions.elect: choose (someone) to hold a position, especially public office, by voting.
definitions.gee: a mild expression of surprise, enthusiasm, or sympathy.
definitions.gel: a jelly-like substance containing a cosmetic, medicinal, or other preparation.
definitions.gene: a unit of heredity which is transferred from a parent to offspring and is held to determine some characteristic of the offspring; in particular, a distinct sequence of DNA forming part of a chromosome.
definitions.gentle: mild and kind in temperament or character.
definitions.get: come to have or hold; receive.
definitions.glen: a narrow valley, especially in Scotland or Ireland.
definitions.lee: (also lee side) the sheltered side; the side away from the wind. Contrasted with weather.
definitions.leg: each of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.
definitions.neglect: fail to give proper care or attention to.
definitions.net: a piece of open-meshed material used typically for catching fish.
definitions.tee: a cleared space on a golf course, from which the ball is struck at the beginning of play for each hole.
definitions.ten: equivalent to the product of five and two; one more than nine; 10.
